hints.text: Division asks how many groups of eight fit in the total. Try taking out a large, easy number of eights first.
$8 \times 60 = 480$ is close to $504$. Subtract $480$ from $504$ and then see how many more eights fit in what is left.

explanation: Take out a big group first: $8 \times 60 = 480$, which uses up most of $504$.
Subtract to see what is still left to share: $504 - 480 = 24$.
The leftover $24$ holds exactly $3$ more eights, because $24 \div 8 = 3$.
Add the two counts of eights: $60 + 3 = 63$, so $504 \div 8 = 63$.
